items.name: poster_createur
items.prompt: A young creator filming a short vertical video with a smartphone on a small tripod and a ring light; around them float three slideshow cards showing a Greek helmet, an atom and an open book, plus a heart bubble and a play-button bubble. Flat poster illustration, paper-cut shapes, limited palette of deep navy blue, saffron yellow, coral red and cream, bold simple forms, subtle paper grain, warm and energetic, centered on a cream background, no text, no outlines.
